name: Thanawat Srisuk (Ton)
whatIEnjoy: Solving algorithmic problems, automating repetitive workflows with Python, and exploring data visualization.
whatIveTried: Python scripting, C programming, basic SQL queries, data cleaning with Pandas, and command-line Git.
whatImCuriousAbout: Machine learning fundamentals, RESTful API design, Docker containers, and cloud deployment.

items.title: Smart Study Schedule & Deadline Tracker
items.description: Built a lightweight command-line and web dashboard tool that parses course syllabi dates and generates weekly study reminders.

reflection.whatIDid: Wrote a Python script to convert CSV deadline tables into structured JSON and rendered upcoming tasks on a clean web page.
reflection.whatILearned: Learned how to handle date/time formatting across timezones and structure clean, reusable JSON schemas.
reflection.challenge: Handling inconsistent date formats from different course syllabus documents without crashing the parser.
reflection.nextStep: Integrate Google Calendar export (.ics) so reminders sync automatically to mobile devices.

items.title: Intro to Git & Open Source Workshop
items.description: Co-organized a hands-on workshop for 40 first-year computer science students covering Git fundamentals, branching, and pull requests.

reflection.whatIDid: Prepared the starter repository with practice issues, wrote a step-by-step cheat sheet, and guided participants through resolving merge conflicts.
reflection.whatILearned: Learned that explaining technical concepts to beginners requires clear visual diagrams and patience when troubleshooting environment setup.
reflection.challenge: Helping students fix SSH key and credential manager issues across both Windows and macOS laptops during the live session.
reflection.nextStep: Record short 5-minute video walkthroughs for common Git commands to share before future club workshops.
